answer:
The author of *Paenitentiam Agere* was **Pope John XXIII** (born Angelo Giuseppe Roncalli). He died on June 3, 1963, at the Apostolic Palace in **Vatican City**.

Vatican City became its own independent country on **February 11, 1929**, when the Lateran Treaty was signed between the Holy See and Italy under Mussolini. The treaty was formally ratified and took effect on June 7, 1929.

So the place where Pope John XXIII died became its own sovereign nation in **1929**, roughly 35 years before his death.
